title: God Made the Plants
objective: Students will learn that God created plants, flowers, and trees.
content: God made all the plants! He made tall trees and little flowers. He made green grass and yummy fruits.
Plants need water and sunshine to grow. God sends the rain and the sunshine to help plants grow big and strong.
We eat many plants that God made! Apples, carrots, and strawberries all come from plants. God gives us good food to eat!
activity: Plant a seed in a cup of dirt. Water it and watch it grow! Color a picture of a flower.
discussion: Who made the plants and trees?
What do plants need to grow?
What is your favorite fruit or vegetable?
